summary: End-to-end verification of the new 'Link to Customer Master' picker in the GST Invoice creation modal + backend customer-lookup endpoint + auto-hydration + historical-snapshot behavior. BACKEND: 10/10 new pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_customer_lookup.py — covers (a) q<2 returns empty, (b) full customer shape (id/customer_name/phone/address/consumer_no/connection_type/warehouse_id/warehouse_name), (c) SFG returns empty phone, (d) lookup by customer_id, (e) unknown customer_id returns null, (f) employee@k3gas.com receives 403, (g) POST /api/gst/invoices with only {customer_id,line_items} auto-hydrates name/phone/address/consumer_no/connection_type + sets customer_source='master', (h) POST without customer_id -> customer_source='manual', (i) historical snapshot: invoice A keeps phone=9990000000 after PUT /api/customers/X {phone:7777700007}; invoice B created afterwards uses the new 7777700007, (j) PUT /api/gst/invoices/{id} (remarks-only edit) after master phone change does NOT clobber the invoice's original phone snapshot. FRONTEND (admin @ /gst-billing -> New Invoice): (1) inv-customer-lookup-input renders at TOP of modal above invoice fields. (2) Debounce works — 1 char produces no dropdown; 3 chars ('BUG') opens inv-customer-lookup-dropdown listing 4 matches, each with data-testid=inv-customer-lookup-item-<id> and showing name + phone (📞 9990000000) + · domestic. (3) Selecting BUG_FIX_VERIFY: inv-customer-name auto-populated ('BUG_FIX_VERIFY Customer'), inv-customer-phone auto-populated ('9990000000'), green 'Linked · Customer DB' badge (inv-customer-linked-badge) appears, chip strip shows 'Customer ID: 199e4fe0… · Consumer No.: 9999911111 · Category: Domestic', inv-customer-phone-warning is HIDDEN. (4) Unlink (inv-customer-unlink) clears the badge and the chip strip but PRESERVES the currently-typed values in inv-customer-name (verified: name still 'BUG_FIX_VERIFY Customer' after unlink). (5) Selecting SFG (empty phone): amber inv-customer-phone-warning banner appears with the link '→ update the Customer Master record' pointing to /customers (href verified), toast 'Customer mobile number is not available in the Customer Database.' fires, inv-customer-phone input is empty, chip strip shows 'Customer ID: 49bc92d8… · Consumer No.: 1111111111 · Category: Domestic'. (6) Invoice View dialog contains data-testid=view-customer-phone (renders 'Not available in Customer DB' in amber for the legacy invoice); view-customer-consumer-no & view-customer-connection-type are conditionally rendered only when their fields are populated — that is the correct spec (legacy invoice K3/2026-27/0274 predates the new fields so both are absent). Existing GSTIN & Warehouse rows remain visible. (7) Party Ledger tab loads with the existing customer grouping (SFG, TEST_IJUM, TEST_CUST_099c24 with phone 9718745223, TEST_CUST_6af0ca) — no regression.
